statement: Acme Photonics says its laser line is sold out and it lifted capacity by 40% in the spring
quote: Our laser line is sold out for the year and we lifted capacity by 40% in the spring.

statement: Acme Photonics has brought a second furnace online
quote: We will bring the second furnace online next quarter, which should ease the shortage.
